purpose: Expected identity of every task-24k fixture provisioning input. scripts/qa/task24/prepare.mjs refuses to provision when an input is absent or does not match these hashes. Hashes are content identities only; no account, credential or snapshot material is published here.
recompute: node scripts/qa/task24/identity-inputs.mjs prints the observed values. Updating a value here is an explicit, reviewed change of the accepted input identity.

archive.note: Read-only historical inputs under LPS_TASK24_HISTORY. wp-content/upgrade, wp-content/cache, wp-content/database, wp-content/themes, wp-content/mu-plugins, wp-content/uploads/lps-qa-media and *.log are excluded from the imported tree: they are rebuilt or replaced by the durable inputs below.

durable.note: In-repository inputs, resolved from the worktree root. The archive is never a fallback for any of them. Every declared mu-plugin must exist and carry bytes or provisioning fails. Entries with a sha256 are frozen QA recoveries owned by this contract and are pinned to it; entries without one are live fixtures owned by their own lane, and the provisioner records their observed hashes in manifests/identity.json for each run.

muPlugins.essential: Loads the content-model plugin before the seed fixtures run; without it the first boot fatals in the seeds.

muPlugins.note: Required by lps-development-bootstrap.php and mapped as a mu-plugin in .wp-env.json; the provisioned runtime mirrors that declared set.
muPlugins.essential: Shared identity of WordPress install-default placeholder content: the bootstrap removes it before any locale adoption, and inspect.php reports the signature so no provision can reintroduce Sample Page or Hello world! as ordinary records.
Serves the ?lps_t24=populate|expired|reset|flush|status fixture states that crosscheck.mjs and the capture matrix require.

administrator.note: Required input of the imported fixture database, validated by ID and granted role only. No login, e-mail address or password material is read or recorded.
